import numpy as np

# Test the depletion function
N_a = 1e17  # p-type doping
N_d = 1e15  # n-type doping
n_i = 1e10  # intrinsic carrier concentration
e_r = 11.7  # relative permittivity for silicon

xn, xp = depletion(N_a, N_d, n_i, e_r)
print(f"xn (n-side depletion width): {xn}")
print(f"xp (p-side depletion width): {xp}")
print(f"Total depletion width: {xn + xp}")

# Verify charge neutrality: N_a * xp should equal N_d * xn
print(f"Charge neutrality check (N_a*xp - N_d*xn): {N_a * xp - N_d * xn}")
